title: The Kind Elephant & The Tiny Ant: No One Is Too Small!

lines.text: Barnaby the giant elephant was the strongest, mightiest animal in the jungle!
lines.caps: Barnaby the giant *ELEPHANT | was the strongest, mightiest animal *IN | the *JUNGLE!

lines.text: Tiny Andy the ant waved his antennae and chirped, Want to be best friends, giant?
lines.caps: Tiny Andy the ant waved his *ANTENNAE | and chirped, Want to be best *FRIENDS, | *GIANT?

lines.text: Barnaby laughed heartily, You are too microscopic to ever help a big elephant like me!
lines.caps: Barnaby laughed *HEARTILY, | You are too microscopic to ever help a big *ELEPHANT | like *ME!

lines.text: The next afternoon, Barnaby's heavy leg stepped into a thick tangle of vines!
lines.caps: The next afternoon, Barnaby's heavy *LEG | stepped into a thick tangle *OF | *VINES!

lines.text: He pulled and trumpeted in panic, but the sturdy knots grew tighter and tighter!
lines.caps: He pulled and trumpeted in *PANIC, | but the sturdy knots grew *TIGHTER | and *TIGHTER!

lines.text: Andy rallied his army of one hundred tiny ants with sharp, helpful jaws!
lines.caps: Andy rallied his army of one hundred *TINY | ants with sharp, helpful *JAWS!

lines.text: Snip, snap, crunch! The tiny ants chewed right through the heavy tangled vines!
lines.caps: Snip, snap, *CRUNCH! | The tiny ants chewed right through the heavy *TANGLED | *VINES!

lines.text: Barnaby stepped free, bowed low, and learned that nobody is ever too small to help!
lines.caps: Barnaby stepped *FREE, | bowed low, and learned that nobody is ever too *SMALL | to *HELP!

lines.text: Help each other every day and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: *HELP each other | every day and *SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS | *RHYMO!
